# MktimeUsage

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Compatibility](/rules/#compatibility) · PhpStorm name: `MktimeUsageInspection`

Two legacy `mktime()` / `gmmktime()` usages:
calling them without arguments just returns the current timestamp (and
emits an `E_STRICT`/deprecation notice on PHP 5.x/7.x) — `time()` is the
intended call; and the seventh `$is_dst` argument was deprecated in PHP 5.1
and removed in PHP 7.0.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{8,9,10,11,12} [Before]
<?php
namespace Billing;

use function gmmktime;

function epoch_values($flag)
{
    $now   = mktime();
    $utc   = gmmktime();
    $root  = \mktime();
    $dst   = mktime(12, 0, 0, 6, 1, 2010, $flag);
    $dst2  = gmmktime(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 2001, 0);
    $noon  = mktime(12);
    $full  = gmmktime(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 2001);
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
namespace Billing;

use function gmmktime;

function epoch_values($flag)
{
    $now   = time();
    $utc   = time();
    $root  = time();
    $dst   = mktime(12, 0, 0, 6, 1, 2010, $flag);
    $dst2  = gmmktime(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 2001, 0);
    $noon  = mktime(12);
    $full  = gmmktime(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 2001);
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 8: Call time() instead; mktime()/gmmktime() without arguments is deprecated.</li>
<li>line 9: Call time() instead; mktime()/gmmktime() without arguments is deprecated.</li>
<li>line 10: Call time() instead; mktime()/gmmktime() without arguments is deprecated.</li>
<li>line 11: The is_dst argument is deprecated and was removed in PHP 7.0.</li>
<li>line 12: The is_dst argument is deprecated and was removed in PHP 7.0.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "MktimeUsage": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore MktimeUsage

/**
 * @noinspection MktimeUsageInspection
 */
```
